title: --dry-run prints the diff and writes nothing, even with --yes
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup instructions, defect N-18): a delimited, reversible JITSO block in the instruction files agents read
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-18, setup instructions). `--dry-run` previews the new file (`--- /dev/null`, `+++ b/AGENTS.md`, the added lines), ends with `jitso setup instructions: dry run, nothing written`, exit 0, and leaves no file and no backup. `--dry-run --yes` is the same. The oracle has no `setup` command: it answers `unknown command "setup"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs this output or file effect FAILS on it.
